summary: CINOS E&S Co., Ltd. is the exclusive distributor for UCT_Ham-Let in South Korea, providing ultra clean diaphragm valves, fittings, and hoses. The company supports semiconductor manufacturing by ensuring a seamless supply and service of UCT products, which include clean gas regulators and smart flow control IoT valves.
